title: Sheafifying an actual finite-free affine ring resolution
statement: Let U be an affine open of a scheme T [def-pc-scheme], and C a cochain complex of quasi-coherent O_U-modules [def-pc-derived-category]. Write A=Γ(U,O_U). Let d be a natural number and P a cochain complex of A-modules whose terms vanish above d and are finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Given an actual quasi-isomorphism f:P→Γ(U,C) (global sections taken termwise), there exists a complex Q of O_U-modules vanishing above d, whose terms are isomorphic to free sheaves on ULift(Fin r) for some natural r in each degree, and an actual quasi-isomorphism Q→C. No pseudo-coherence hypothesis, construction of P, lower bound or geometric morphism is needed.

source.place: Lemma 26.7.5 (Tag 01IB), affine equivalence; Lemma 26.5.4 (Tag 01HV), exactness of associated sheaf

proof.text: Set X=U.toScheme and A=Γ(X,⊤). The canonical affine isomorphism X≅Spec A transports the tilde/global-sections adjunction to X. Its counit on each quasi-coherent term C.X n is invertible; naturality gives an isomorphism of cochain complexes tilde(Γ(C))≅C.

Apply transported tilde termwise to P and f. At every prime its action is module localization; localization is exact and stalks detect exactness. Thus it preserves homology and sends the given quasi-isomorphism f to a quasi-isomorphism. Compose with the counit complex isomorphism to produce Q→C. Its terms above d are zero because tilde preserves zero objects.

For each n, freeness and finiteness give a finite basis of P.X n. Reindex it by ULift (Fin r), using r=0 if the module is zero. The basis isomorphism identifies P.X n with the finite direct sum of A. The left adjoint tilde sends this to the direct sum of the structure sheaf, namely SheafOfModules.free (ULift (Fin r)); affine restriction preserves the unit and coproducts. These choices are made inside the existential proof only. For the zero ring or empty scheme all modules and sheaves are zero, and rank zero works.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01IB and 01HV, applied termwise to complexes; finite free associated sheaves from coproduct preservation

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_sheaf_resolution_of_ring_model
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (U : T.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme]
    (C : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hCqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u}
        (U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤))) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hfree : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free (U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤)) (P.X i) ∧
      Module.Finite (U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤)) (P.X i))
    (f : P ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf
      (.op ⊤)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj C)
    [QuasiIso f] :
    ∃ Q : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ, Q.IsStrictlyLE d ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free
        (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) ∧
      ∃ e : Q ⟶ C, QuasiIso e
